prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the basic modules of computer science and the advanced modules of software engineering and software practicals are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: can systematically familiarize themselves with a given software project
can develop a coherent evolution plan
can carry out minor evolution tasks
are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion
can work on a project in a team

syllabus_topics: Special challenges of long-lived software systems
Technical and organizational aspects of targeted software evolution
Methods, techniques, and tools for software evolution

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual examination) or written examination

assessment_rules: Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance will be an oral examination or a written examination.
bibliography: Will be specified in the module announcement.
